summary: Implement the Companion local-owner payment boundary for Topnet V1.1 on the current canonical runtime.
reason: The conversational channel must not create the live payment before the owner biometric. The runtime now prepares inert owner intent data, creates the live PaymentRecord only after trusted local-start, persists the single dispatch guard first, and carries the local authorization contract through bank continuation.

rollback: Revert the scoped runtime commits while keeping external live disabled; engaged or indeterminate payment records must never be replayed.
limitations: No real positive financial acceptance was executed during this engineering validation.
External live payment creation remains disabled.
A positive owner-initiated Topnet V1.1 acceptance is still required before capability promotion.
